run_find_adsorbate_binding_sites: run find_adsorbate_binding_sites to search for adsorbate binding sites on surfaces of a bulk material
run_wait_for_adsorbate_slab_relaxations: run wait_for_adsorbate_slab_relaxations to block until all relaxations in a system have finished
run_get_adsorbate_slab_relaxation_result: run get_adsorbate_slab_relaxation_results to fetch relaxation results for a given system ID
review_AdsorbateBindingSites: review the AdsorbateBindingSites dataclass that stores inputs and results of adsorbate placement relaxations on slabs
review_Lifetime: review the Lifetime enum that represents SAVE, MARK_EPHEMERAL, and DELETE options for relaxation data retention
